title: All armies
notes: The buildings and Nexus powers any Commander may use, and the content the first campaign's levels put on the Grid. At the size of what exists: the disposable bench rosters (Citizen and Ravel) and the bench buildings PERIMETER has always offered, with no balance claim, and two placeholder Nexus powers. Choosing the Citizens' real roster, its balance and the effect kinds behind real Nexus powers are still to come. The content definitions themselves (stats, footprints) are still TypeScript in src/content: this army names the ids it brings, and the loader checks that each exists. The Ravel units are here, not in a Ravel army, because they are the raid's bench units and no Ravel Commander exists yet. The three buildings have three footprints (3x2, 2x2, 1x1), so placement exercises three anchor calculations and three ways to straddle a rock; their costs are round numbers, not balance, and real costs wait for the content-iteration milestone. Each Nexus power's description fits the 28 glyphs a panel row has at the 80-column floor.
